subject: Logic
title: The Multiplication Rule
description: A 60-second lesson on The Multiplication Rule.

hook.text: What's the chance of drawing two aces in a row? You need both probabilities—and how they connect.

buildup.text: For independent events: P(A and B) = P(A) × P(B). Two coin flips: 0.5 × 0.5 = 0.25.

discovery.text: For dependent events: P(A and B) = P(A) × P(B|A). The second probability adjusts for the first.

twist.text: Forgetting to adjust for dependence is one of the most common probability mistakes in real problems.

climax.text: Multiply probabilities in sequence—but always check whether earlier outcomes change later ones.

quiz.question: How do you calculate P(A and B) for dependent events?
